state.paragraph: Later on June 28, 2013, Party B, entered into a confidentiality and standstill agreement with Mac-Gray and was provided with an informational package for the purpose of providing Party B with data to formulate a preliminary indication of interest.

ledger_rows.Note: Board forms a Special Committee of six independent directors, excluding CEO MacDonald and Moab's Rothenberg. The committee will weigh a sale against staying stand-alone and approach 50 parties.
BofA's outreach carries out the 06/24 decision; contacts reported by 06/28. NDA signers get an informational package, with preliminary IOIs due 07/23/2013 (no separate Deadline set row).
Target-initiated. Pamplona is interested, including an acquisition by its portfolio company CSC (acquired May 2013), and says diligence would be minimal.

ledger_rows.When: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013
ledger_rows.Note: Target outreach. Of 50 contacted (15 strategic, 35 financial), Party A (#2) and CSC/Pamplona (#10) are recorded separately, leaving 13 strategic parties.

ledger_rows.When: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013
ledger_rows.Note: Target outreach to all 35 financial parties (including private equity), among them Party B and Party C. 50 contacted in total.

ledger_rows.When: over the two months after late June 2013
ledger_rows.Note: 20 NDAs in total (2 strategic, 18 financial). Party A, CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party C have their own rows, leaving 16 financial. Signing dates not given; each got an informational package.
Confidentiality and standstill agreement; received the informational package.
Confidentiality and standstill agreement; received the informational package.
Refuses rollover partnership: denies the request (relayed by Rothenberg 07/03) for Moab to partner exclusively with CSC/Pamplona on a rollover. Such talks allowed only later.
Agreement with Pamplona Capital Management LLC, reused in the merger agreement (s. 6.17). Received the informational package. Party A's NDA talks stalled on non-solicit terms 07/11-07/23.
Due date for preliminary IOIs. CSC/Pamplona bid on time; Party B and Party C bid on 07/24 and were considered on 07/25 (late bids accepted).

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
